RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

An all-female panel alone is not evidence of bias, just as an all-male panel does not inherently indicate discrimination. For a "head of" leadership role, regulatory relations, governance, and executive communication are often prioritized over pure statistical depth, making a finance background with regulatory experience a compelling fit. Furthermore, a two-week delay for written feedback is standard in corporate HR processes. 

Raising allegations of gender bias without concrete evidence will appear unprofessional and could damage your reputation in the banking sector. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting feedback focused purely on your candidacy and the competencies needed for future leadership opportunities.
